question_text: Mayor Rodrigo is a member of the Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) of his city. His wife owns a construction company that regularly bids for city infrastructure projects. Under RA 6713, which of the following actions by Mayor Rodrigo is PROHIBITED?

options.text: He discloses his wife's ownership to the BAC and abstains from voting on her company's bids.
He continues to participate in BAC deliberations but does not vote on his wife's bids.
He resigns from the BAC and his wife's company continues to bid.
He requests a legal opinion from the DILG on whether he has a conflict of interest.
